0.reason: `_ConvNd.get_delta_weight` is the only implementation, and Conv3d inherits it. It checks `weight.size()[2:4] == (1, 1)` and then squeezes dims 3 and 2, which assumes 4D Conv2d weights. For a Conv3d with kernel (1,1,1), A has shape (r,in,1,1,1) and B has shape (out,r,1,1,1). After the squeezes they become (r,in,1) and (out,r,1), so the matmul fails on mismatched dimensions. A kernel like (1,1,3) also satisfies the check, because it only looks at dims 2 and 3. That drops real dimensions and breaks the same way.
